faq.q: What standards apply to titanium orifice plate (flow meter)?
faq.a: Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply depending on the application and regulatory requirements.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium orifice plate (flow meter)?
faq.a: With proper material selection (Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V) and manufacturing process control (thread rolling, heat treatment), titanium titanium orifice plate (flow meter) components exhibit excellent fatigue life and corrosion resistance in service.

faq.q: What surface treatments are available for titanium orifice plate (flow meter)?
faq.a: Common surface treatments include Passivation ASTM F86. These enhance corrosion resistance, wear properties, and aesthetic appearance.
